paragraphs.text: The night market on Harbour Street opens at six in the evening and closes at midnight. It began in 1994 with eleven stalls; today there are more than sixty, and half of them sell food.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Traders pay a fixed fee for a pitch, whatever they sell. The market is run by a committee of traders rather than by the city, and any profit is spent on lighting and cleaning.
paragraphs.label: B

items.prompt: The market opens earlier in summer than in winter.
The market has fewer stalls now than when it started.
All traders pay the same fee for a pitch.
The city council manages the market.
